offer_text: 25-cent martinis at weekday lunch (limit 3 per person). Yes, a quarter. The most famous deal in New Orleans dining.
$3 unlimited daily pass for all streetcars and buses. Also available: 3-day ($9), 5-day ($15), 31-day ($55).
Big Kid tickets (ages 5-12) for $15 vs $25 adult. Under 5 free. Shows at 5pm and 6pm are less crowded.
Free admission for active-duty military and up to 3 dependents. Louisiana residents get discounted admission.
Multi-attraction pass covering 25+ experiences — WWII Museum, swamp tours, walking tours, riverboat cruise. 1-5 day options. Save 40%+ vs individual tickets.
$10 admission every Thursday 6-8pm includes live music, cocktails, and full gallery access. Best deal in the city for culture.
$8 for 24-hour access with 30-min ride intervals. $15 for 3-day access. Stations throughout tourism districts.
Online booking discount: save $5-10 per ticket when booking cruises online in advance vs at the dock.
New twice-daily route connecting New Orleans to Mobile, AL with Gulf Coast stops (Biloxi, Gulfport, Bay St. Louis). Affordable car-free day trips starting around $15 each way.
Most clubs on Frenchmen Street have no cover charge. Free world-class live music nightly at Spotted Cat, d.b.a., Blue Nile, Mahogany Jazz Hall, and more.
August restaurant month: 100+ restaurants offer prix fixe lunch ($25) and dinner ($45) menus. The best dining deal of the year at top restaurants.
Daily happy hour at the bar: discounted oysters, select wines, and cocktails. One of the best happy hours in the city.
Bar menu available for walk-ins with smaller plates and cocktails at lower prices than the full dining room.

All-inclusive sightseeing pass: 1-day ($60), 2-day ($90), 3-day ($120), 5-day ($155). Covers WWII Museum, swamp tours, walking tours, Mardi Gras World, riverboat cruise. Save 40%+ vs individual tickets.
Swamp tours regularly available at 20-30% off on Viator and Groupon. Book 2-3 days ahead for best pricing. Most include hotel pickup.
Many hotels offer stay-and-dine packages during slower months (June, August, September). Check hotel websites directly for bundled room + restaurant credit deals.
Weekday wine specials: discounted bottles and cheese plates Mon-Thu. The most romantic cheap date in the city.
